title: Verification Response
description: Response returned by POST /verify and GET /verification/{businessTransactionId}. A Verification, plus an optional settlement field: present only on the GET route's response (see routes/verify-get.ts), and only once a Settlement Confirmation exists for this Business Transaction (M4b — a refund's lifecycle closed via fetch-verified webhook processing). Never silent: a settled or settlement-failed refund is always visible here, not only by separately fetching the whole Trust Record.

settlement.description: Present only when at least one Settlement Confirmation exists for this Business Transaction. Reflects the LATEST confirmation.

status.description: SETTLED when the fetch-verified refund status was "processed"; SETTLEMENT_FAILED otherwise. Derived exclusively from the fetched state, never from a webhook's own claimed event type.

fetchedRefundStatus.description: The refund's status exactly as fetched from Razorpay's API at confirmation time (e.g. "processed", "failed").

razorpayRefundId.description: The Razorpay refund id this confirmation is about.

issuedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this Settlement Confirmation was issued.
